# wallix-bastion_apikey (Data Source)

Get information on an API key by its name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get information about a specific API key
data "wallix-bastion_apikey" "ci_pipeline" {
  apikey_name = "ci_pipeline"
}

# Use the IP limitation to decide whether the key is unrestricted
output "ci_pipeline_apikey_unrestricted" {
  value = length(data.wallix-bastion_apikey.ci_pipeline.ip_limitation) == 0
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `apikey_name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `apikey` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ip_limitation` (String)

## Usage Notes

### Lookup Key

`apikey_name` is the required lookup key. The data source returns an error if no API key with
that name exists on the Bastion.

### The `apikey` attribute

The Bastion API only returns the key in the response to its creation request: the `apikey`
attribute of this data source always reads back as a masked placeholder (`********`). Use this
data source to check metadata (name, IP limitation) about an existing key, not to retrieve its
usable secret value; a key created by the `wallix-bastion_apikey` resource is in its `apikey`
attribute.

### IP Limitation

`ip_limitation` is a comma-separated list of IP addresses allowed to use the key. An empty value
means the key can be used from any IP.
